description: C5.05 (SLO #11, MG-13, PF-10): one durable run's cache-read share, from the usage a provider reports on each model call to the metric its end records. Python drives the Model Gateway with a scripted provider that reports each call's `usage` ({input, output, cacheRead, cacheWrite}; input counts every prompt token, the cache's read and write are parts of it, C37) and checks the run's ledger `used` and the body it sends Node's ledger; Node commits the same usage on its ledger, closes the run, records the closed account and checks the histogram sample: `ratio` is used.cacheRead / used.input, observed once per run in the bucket whose bound is `bucket` (the first of the histogram's bounds at or above it). `belowFloor` says whether that run alone sits under the 70% floor HarnessCacheReadShareLow alarms on.

runs.name: an engine resending its history: the cache serves all but the turn it appends
a long run past its first call: the first call's cold prompt matters less with every call
